main.description: A patron's signed proof that a quest was delivered and PAID PEER-TO-PEER — the objective delivery anchor + eligibility context for delivery/split attestations. The platform never custodies funds; parties pay each other directly via any rail and this record attests the OUTCOME only (no card data / PII). The payee co-signs by confirming receipt (a pays.promptly attestation). Carry `evidence` (e.g. a crypto txid) so independent auditors can check it; un-evidenced payments are flagged. Written to the patron's repo.

payee.description: The guild (AT-URI / id) or builder DID that was paid.

party.description: Builder DIDs on the delivering party (grants splits.fair eligibility).

amount.description: Gross amount in minor units (e.g. cents) — integer, never a float. Settled off-protocol; recorded here for the trail.

paymentRef.description: Opaque off-protocol payment reference (e.g. a Venmo note or bank memo). NEVER card numbers or PII.

evidence.description: Independently-checkable proof of payment — ideally a crypto txid (verifiable on-chain by anyone). Settlements with no evidence are flagged by the auditor.
